div.div:
int digitToString(void *source, char destination[], size_t destSize, char typeOfNumber)
Takes a long/int number and transorms it to the same number but as an char array and saves it in the destination array, returns integer that says how many digits were transformed(at the same time it is also the number of elements that were writed to array).
If the length of number was bigger than array capacity returns 0 and prints "INVALID", the same also if it cannot be transformed because of other reasons.
Note: if length of the card number is 16 the size of array must be 17 because of '\0'
